name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Fenwick goes with at least one of Dwarf, Divination, or Necromancy.
Lyra, Dragonborn, and Enchantment belong to different adventurers.
Dragonborn goes with either Lyra or Thorne.
Half-Orc goes with neither Thorne nor Wrenna.
Necromancy goes with neither Lyra nor Half-Orc.
